title: Ruuhu Gadano Darnde
intro: Ko ɓooyaani ko nelaaɗo gooto yahrata e leydi, ko adii nde binndol ngol feeñata, tagoore nde nanndaani e goɗɗo oo arii e tagoore. Ooɗoo ruuhu ko juuɗe Alla mbayli ɗum, rokka ɗum nokku ɗo ŋarɗugol mum alaa ɗo haaɗi, jarribaama e mbaadi ndi njiylotoɗen e nder daartol aadee fof. Ko rewi heen ko daartol tampere, tuubugol laaɓtungol, e daɗndo ngo waylata laawol tagoore ndee haa abada. Mbele aɗa waawi teskaade hol oo?
clues: Mi mbaylaama e juuɗe Joom yurmeende gila e ɓuuɓri leydi
Mi rokkaama galle mo alaa ko nanndi e mum, ɗo heege walla tampere waawaa meemde mi
Mi yamiraama hoto mi ɓadto hay lekki gooto, sabu ko ɗum haram
Miin e sehil am min majjinaama min ɓadtii lekki kaɗaaki kii, min luutndii yamiroore Joomiraawo amen
En ngartii e Joomiraawo men e tuubuubuye laaɓɗe, en njaafaama tooñannge men
E men, neɗɗaagu fof jippii; Ko miin woni gadano yahde e dow ndii leydi

outcome.label: Keeɓal
options: Nelaaɗo e leydi ko toppitiiɗo neɗɗaagu gadano
Firaawna e konu mum njolii e nder maayo
outcome.answer: Nelaaɗo e leydi ko toppitiiɗo neɗɗaagu gadano

arabic: قَالَا رَبَّنَا ظَلَمْنَآ أَنفُسَنَا وَإِن لَّمْ تَغْفِرْ لَنَا وَتَرْحَمْنَا لَنَكُونَنَّ مِنَ ٱلْخَـٰسِرِينَ
verse: They said, "Our Lord, we have wronged ourselves, and if You do not forgive us and have mercy upon us, we will surely be among the losers." (7:23)
